model_output.verdict: An experienced accountant with substantial accounts payable work and a few responsibilities still left vague.
write_up: A recruiter sees an accountant with experience in Vietnam and the US, now processing around 400 vendor invoices a month. The main question is what you handle during the current month-end close.

The strongest line is the reduction in closing time from 12 days to 7 days. It names the work, the change and how you made it. Use that level of detail to explain the junior accountants' work and your current closing duties.

cards.line: - Help the controller for month end closing
cards.cannot_tell: Help could mean several things. A recruiter can't tell which closing tasks were yours.
cards.example: Help the controller with month end closing by [specific tasks]
cards.question: Which month-end closing tasks do you help the controller with?

cards.cannot_tell: The team size is clear, but not what the junior accountants handled. Their work would show what you led.
cards.example: Lead a team of 3 junior accountants who [team responsibilities]
cards.question: What work did the 3 junior accountants handle?

cards.line: - Reduce the month end closing from 12 days to 7 days by make new checklist and template
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. It shows the change and the checklist and template behind it.

fit.note: Your current invoice work points toward accounts payable roles. Your general ledger, financial statement and closing work also gives a recruiter a reason to consider you for staff accountant roles.
